author: iFixit
description:
The Oura Ring has become one of the most popular health trackers on the planet. It tracks your sleep, heart rate, activity, and recovery—all from a device smaller than a wedding band. 

But every Oura Ring has one unavoidable problem. The battery will eventually fail and there's no way to replace it. Today we're tearing down the new Oura Ring 5 to see exactly why.
